_comment: The seven per-layer linears of smolvlm_expert_prefill_trunk, extracted as NATIVE conv-layout sub-models rather than rewritten in place. This is the only form in which the experts reach an accelerator at all: rewriting the trunk's MatMuls to Conv1x1 with rewrite_matmul_to_conv1x1.py wraps every conv in a rank-3->4->3 Transpose/Reshape pair, and the v66 DSP then refuses to finalize the graph (rpc / error 6022) at EVERY granularity tested -- 1588 ops, 794, and even a single 103-op layer -- while the same layer in MatMul form composes fine at 73 ops. Built directly as [1,C,1,113] Conv(1x1) and converted WITHOUT --preserve_io layout, the converter declares the input NHWC [1,1,113,C] and emits zero layout ops, and all three blocks then compose on cpu, dsp AND hta -- the first time anything expert-shaped has reached HTA. Backends per tile are exactly the context binaries present at /root/models/smolvla_expert_nc on the board; all 9 exist. SCOPE: these are LAYER 0's linears only. The interleaving CPU work (RoPE, attention, RMSNorm, the residual stream) is not yet cut into tiles, and layers 1-15 need their own weights extracted, so this manifest is not yet a runnable whole-network binding -- it is the linear tiles plus their measured cells. op ranges index the trunk ONNX node list.

bindings.name: nc_qkv
bindings._role: q(960->960), k(960->320), v(960->320) from mul_1, the post-RMSNorm activation

bindings.name: nc_oproj
bindings._role: attention output projection (960->960) from _unsafe_view_2; depends on tile 0 only through the attention block, which is still CPU-resident and untiled

bindings.name: nc_mlp
bindings._role: SwiGLU: gate(960->2560), up(960->2560), down(2560->960) plus Sigmoid and two Mul, from mul_14. The only block where an accelerator wins: hta 2452 us vs cpu 4415 us, 1.80x.
